import os,runpy,sys,tempfile
code=sys.stdin.read()
fd,path=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="picoagent-",suffix=".py",dir="/tmp")
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(code)
    sys.argv=[path]
    runpy.run_path(path,run_name="__main__")
finally:
    os.unlink(path)
